name: Math answer
description: Type a mathematical answer in LaTeX or plain notation and see it rendered as you type. Graded by checking equivalence, so any correct form is accepted: x(x+1) and x^2+x, or 1/2 and \frac{1}{2}.

fields.name: answers
fields.description: Accepted answers in LaTeX or plain notation. Any one is enough. A list like \{2, 3\} or 2, 3 is compared as a set.

fields.name: form
fields.description: any (every equivalent form) | exact (no decimals) | same (also the same form, up to the order of terms and factors, e.g. for 'factor this')

fields.name: ordered
fields.description: Compare lists in order instead of as sets.
